Animal Welfare, Injuries, and Safety Reforms

Coverage that centers on the risks to horses, injuries or fatalities, veterinary care, and safety reforms specific to the Grand National and Aintree’s National fences.

Race Reports, Previews, and Sporting Competition

Coverage focused on the racing itself at Aintree: the Grand National and associated festival races, performances, course and obstacle details, and race-day proceedings, excluding betting and celebrity angles.

Betting Markets, Odds, Tips, and Bookmaker Activity

Coverage that foregrounds gambling on the Grand National or Aintree Festival: odds, favourites, tips, specials, market moves, and bookmaker promotions.

Celebrities, Fashion, and Social Scene at Aintree

Coverage emphasizing celebrity attendees, fashion and style (especially Ladies Day), entertainment acts, hospitality, and the event’s social atmosphere at Aintree.
